design: 8 name triples x all 6 permutations x 3 cyclic entry orders x all 3 queries = 432 prompts. Positions and token counts fixed within blocks; every key occupies each entry position across order rotations.
competence: Report three-way candidate accuracy, full-vocabulary top1, all-three-query block accuracy and nonquery-rival accuracy for nonfixed queries. Strong gate requires >=75% all-three-query blocks and >=50% full-top1 per permutation kind. No individual-case filtering.
intervention: Replace one source-to-head bus contribution at final destination with mean of the three name-value vectors. Other paths and downstream computation live. Self adds zero.
hypotheses: Three-way success requires evidence separating two nonquery alternatives, beyond suppressing the query.
The frozen heads preferentially copy the correct value if they select an association.
Broad copying with query correction predicts weak correct-value preference and possible failure on cycles or fixed points.
scope: No head fitting or selection. Individual head/source neutralizations, not exhaustive ablations. Known names in new combinations, not training-data holdout.
